meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在 agent 容器里装好 Vercel CLI，并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭据，之后 agent 就能把网页应用部署到 Vercel。
howto.when: 当你希望让 agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发；若 OneCLI 未就绪，会先让你运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我在 Vercel 上的所有部署
检查一下当前 Vercel 的登录身份

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds the Vercel CLI to the agent container and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials, so the agent can deploy web apps to Vercel.
howto.when_en: Use when you want the agent to deploy web applications to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, it tells you to run /init-onecli first, then retry.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production
Check which Vercel account I'm logged in as
